title: NP-Hardness of Constant-Factor Approximation for Densest k-Subgraph
exact_target: Is approximating the maximum number of edges induced by exactly $k$ vertices within some fixed nontrivial constant factor already NP-hard?

sources.citation: Bundit Laekhanukit, Pasin Manurangsi and Ohad Trabelsi, A Note on Approximability of Densest At-Least-k-Subgraph, arXiv:2605.25464v1 (25 May 2026).
